tasks.title: Email about York exchange visit activities
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English teacher, Mrs. Clark, and the notes you have made.

promptBlocks.subject: York exchange visit – activities
paragraphs: Thank you for agreeing to help plan the school exchange visit to York. We need to choose two main activities for the group. The options are: a guided tour of York Minster, a visit to the Jorvik Viking Centre, or a walk along the city walls.
Which two activities do you think we should choose? Please give a reason for each choice. Also, would you prefer to have the activities on the same day or on different days? Why?
Let me know your ideas by Friday.

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Choose two activities and say why you chose each one.
Say if you prefer same day or different days – explain why.
Suggest one thing the group should do in the evening.
Ask Mrs. Clark about the budget for activities.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs. Clark using all the notes.

tasks.title: Article about York exchange visit
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: You see this notice on a specialist magazine website for exchange programme coordinators.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: How can a school exchange visit help students learn about history and culture?

Write an article for our magazine describing one activity from a real or imaginary exchange visit that you think was especially effective. Explain what students learned from it and why you would recommend it to other coordinators.
The best articles will be published on our website.

tasks.title: Story about an exchange visit problem
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.
Your story must begin with this sentence:
"When the programme coordinator announced that the museum was closed, everyone looked worried."
